forumThreads.title: Audi EA839 3.0T Cylinder 2 & 5 Misfire Under Heavy Boost - Coil breakdown vs Injector fouling
forumThreads.problemSummary: Encountering intermittent P0302 on 2021-2023 Audi Q7 3.0T with 40k-50k miles. Customers report hesitation when merging onto highway under 50%+ throttle. Freeze frame indicates misfire occurs right at 2,100 RPM at peak boost pressure.
forumThreads.confirmedSolution: Swap test confirms coil secondary dielectric breakdown. When plug gaps widen over 40k miles to ~1.15mm, required ignition ionization voltage spikes from 14kV to over 28kV, causing coil body to punch internal arc. ALWAYS replace all 6 plugs when replacing the failed coil pack.

replies.message: Spot on Marcus. We saw 3 of these last month. The factory plug spec is 0.7mm (+/- 0.05). If you just swap the coil without replacing plugs, the new coil fails within 90 days. Great write-up!

forumThreads.title: Tesla Model Y / 3 12V AGM Low Voltage Warning after software update - Parasitic draw isolation
forumThreads.problemSummary: Vehicle alerts customer via app '12V battery requires service soon'. DC-DC converter output reads 14.4V while driving, but resting voltage drops to 11.9V overnight.
forumThreads.confirmedSolution: Third-party USB dashcam plugged into center console port was preventing car from entering deep sleep. Car's high-voltage contactor was cycling 40 times per day to keep 12V charged. Unplugged USB accessory, load tested 12V battery (replaced with Interstate MTX AGM), problem completely resolved.
